principle: VERTICAL PLAYBOOK registry (backs registry #93): each business VERTICAL's management-workflow SHAPE + the registries/components that COMPOSE it into a DAG. Outside-the-box framing: a 'dental clinic management tool' is NOT bespoke software — it's a DAG the federation assembles (schedule + records + billing + recall) from the buffet (the consumption_model, applied to a market). Generalizes architecture/adjacent_verticals.json to the management-tool layer. serves_truth=false; no PII stored here (shapes only); regulated verticals (healthcare) route PII through redaction + human review; NO insurance verticals (repo rule).
